title: [bugfix] #1874 Add Bootstrap form style for CodeMirror editor
issueTitle: Bug report: CSS issue - Unable to focus 'Find' field using cursor
why: The bug only appears at certain panel widths, which you have to set by dragging the right-panel divider, and it is a CSS mouse-blocking problem rather than a wrong Output value, so there is no reliable visible fact to check at the default layout.
